Solid lines and plain labels are **Confirmed**; dashed yellow nodes are **Proposed**; dashed red nodes are **Blocked/TODO**. Labels read `Pin <NanoKit pin> / GPIO<n>` so the physical NanoKit header pin and the ESP32 GPIO are always shown together. Render to PNG/SVG with `python tools/genius/generate.py --render`.
